components.title: Paprika Turkey Meatballs
ingredients: ¼ cup homemade Ezekiel Bread Crumbs or
1 package extra lean ground turkey breast
Low sodium chicken stock for cooking.
instructions: In a large skillet add chicken stock to medium heat.
Add the onions, celery and garlic and sauté until cooked.
Transfer a little over a cup of the onion mixture to a large bowl and let cool.
In a food processor, puree the tomatoes and roasted peppers.
Add the puree to the skillet and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Stir in the paprika.
Add the mixture to a big pot and cook.
Whisk the breadcrumbs, egg whites into the remaining onion mixture.
Mix in the turkey and form meatballs.
Add the meatballs to the pot and cook until done.

components.title: Mashed Sweet Potato
ingredients: ½ cup fat-free shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Peel and boil the sweet potatoes until soft.
Cut the potatoes in chunks and place them in a food processor, add the starchy water, the cottage cheese and the shredded cheddar cheese and blend until smooth and creamy.

recipes.name: Moroccan Chicken with Mango Relish
sides: Arugula Salad with Palms, Artichokes and Citrus Dressing

components.title: Morracan Chicken with Mango relish
ingredients: 1 15-ounce can hearts of palms, drained and
instructions: Season both sides of each chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Rub cumin and coriander all over both sides.
Heat chicken stock in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chicken and cook on both sides until done.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine mango and cilantro.
Top tilapia with mango mixture just before serving. and Citrus Dressing (6 Servings) Combine marmalade, with lemon juice, mustard, salt and pepper to taste and whisk in olive oil.
Pour dressing over salad and top with almonds.

components.title: Quinoa Salad
ingredients: ½ jar of roasted peppers, chopped
instructions: Cook the Quinoa per instructions and add a dash of complete seasoning to the boiling water.
Once cooked, add roasted peppers, pine nuts, arugula, and goat cheese crumbles.
Mix well to combine and serve.

components.title: White Fish Tomato & Artichoke
ingredients: 4 Fillets of your favorite white fish
1 ½ cup low sodium chicken stock
instructions: Season the fish with salt and pepper and grill for approximately 4 minutes per side.
In a medium sauce pan, heat a little stock and cook the shallots, add the garlic and artichokes and cook until golden brown.
Add the stock, tomatoes, and juice, thyme and a little s&p.
Laddle the mixture into bowls and top with the fish.
Serve immediately.

components.title: Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Pre-heat the oven to 425 degrees.
Line a baking sheet with foil.
Place all the veggies on the pan and sprinkle with your favorite dried herbs or seasoning blends.
Fold in with your hands and make sure veggies are all flat and spread along the sheet.
Roast in the oven for 25 minutes.

components.title: Country Curry Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast cut in pieces
2/3 cup low sodium chicken stock, plus more for
instructions: Combine Curry and grill seasoning and sprinkle over chicken.
Heat stock in a skillet and add chicken to pan and cook until browned.
Add onion, pepper and garlic and sauté for about 3 minutes.
Add broth, cranberries, and 1 tbsp thyme, add tomatoes and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in remaining thyme and cook one more minute.
Sprinkle almonds on top and serve

components.title: Parmesan Broccoli and Cauliflower
instructions: Place the veggies in a bowl.
Toss the egg whites and coat evenly over the veggies.
Place the Parmesan in a large tray and dredge the veggies in it.
In a sauté pan place a little low sodium stock and cook the veggies until they are browned.

components.title: Chicken with Peach Relish
ingredients: ½ cup finely chopped red onion
instructions: For relish, combine first 6 ingredients in a medium bowl, let stand for a few minutes.
Preheat oven to 375.
Sprinkle chicken with grill seasoning and bake on a baking sheet for 25 minutes.
When done, top with peach relish and serve.

components.title: Orange Quinoa
ingredients: 1 ¾ cup low sodium chicken stock
instructions: In a saucepan, bring stock to boil.
Add orance quice and quinoa and reduce heat to low, cover and cook until liquid is absorbed.
Fluff quinoa with a fork and fold in cranberries, almonds and parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken with Nectarine Salad
recipes.note: From Michelle's Eat to be Fit cooking class #7. The 2nd-edition PDF lists it on week 1 but left the recipe out.

components.title: Chicken with Nectarine Salad
ingredients: ½ tbsp coconut sugar or brown sugar
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the first 6 ingredients and rub onto both sides of the chicken breasts.
Bake in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes or until done.
In a separate bowl, combine the remaining ingredients, except the avocado, and fold it in at the end.
To serve, plate the chicken and top with the salsa.

components.title: Broccoli Puree
ingredients: 1 russet potato, peeled and cut into chunks
½ cup low sodium chicken stock
½ cup reduced fat cottage cheese
¼ cup reduced fat Parmesan cheese
instructions: Fill a large pot of water to boil, add the potatoes and boil over high heat.
Cook until soft, after about 6-8 minutes add the broccoli to the water.
Transfer the potatoes to a bowl and mash.
Add the broccoli to a food processor, add the cottage cheese, stock, and Parmesan, and puree.
Add the mashed potatoes and puree a little more.
Season with s&p to taste

components.title: Quinoa Salad with Roasted Veggies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
Cook Quinoa in 2 cups of water.
In a sauté pan cook the onions, garlic and cumin.
Sprinkle the veggies with paprika and pepper.
Place in a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes.
In a large bowl mix the quinoa, onion mixture and roasted veggies.
Add the parsley and cheese and fold in.
Serve with chicken, turkey or shrimp.

recipes.name: White Fish with Edamame & Pepper Relish

components.title: White Fish with Edamame & Pepper Relish
instructions: To prepare relish, thaw the corn and edamame and add to a bowl.
Add the roasted pepper, green onions, and the next 5 ingredients, toss to combine.
Sprinkle the fish with grill seasoning and grill or sauté in a pan with stock until done.
Serve by adding relish on top.

components.title: Chicken Veggies & Rice Risotto
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast cut into chunks
instructions: In a skillet add stock and cook chicken until done.
Add onions, ginger, cumin, coriander and grill seasoning, and garlic.
Cook for a few minutes.
Add tomatoes, rice, cranberries and broth, bring to a boil.
Cover and reduce heat and simmer.
As the liquid evaporates add more stock a little at a time until the rice is tender.
When done, stir in cilantro and almonds.

components.title: Tomato-Artichoke Chicken
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and rinced and
Dried garlic, oregano and basil to taste.
instructions: In a skillet with stock sprinkle the chicken on both sides with grill seasoning and cook until done.
Set aside and keep warm.
In the same skillet add the tomatoes, artichokes, dried herbs and vinegar.
Bring to a simmer and cook for a few minutes.
To serve, pour over the chicken.

components.title: Sesame Mango Chicken
instructions: Pour stock in a skillet and brown the chicken.
Add the garlic, ginger, and pepper and cook for a few minutes.
Add the diced mango and cook until tender.
Add the tomatoes and the limejuice and simmer for a few minutes.
Sprinkle the sesame seeds on top and serve.

components.title: Chili Rubbed Flank Steak
instructions: Rub the meat with a mixture of grill seasoning, chili powder and lime zest.
Let stand for a few minutes and grill until cooked about 6 minutes on each side.
For the rice, heat a medium saucepan on medium heat and add stock and cook the rice for a couple of minutes.
Add the onion, pepper, and garlic and cook until veggies soften.
Add the stock and water and bring to a boil, stir in the tomato paste and reduce heat to simmer.
Cover the pan and cook until done.
Sprinkle with cilantro

recipes.name: Turkey Chili and Sweet Potato Shepherd’s Pie

components.title: Turkey Chili and Sweet Potato Shepherd’s Pie
ingredients: 1 tbsp each of paprika, cumin, and coriander
Low fat shredded cheddar to taste
instructions: In a large pot, add the potatoes, fill with water and bring to a boil.
Cook until tender.
Drain and return to the pot adding zest and cottage cheese and s&p to taste and mash.
Meanwhile in a pot add stock and brown the turkey with s&p.
Then add the onion, peppers and garlic and cook.
Add all the spices and cook for a few minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for another few minutes.
Stir in the stock a little at a time until desired thickness.
Transfer the chili to a casserole dish, spread the mash potato mixture on top and top with cheese.
Brown in the oven on broil for a few minutes until golden brown.

components.title: Oat & Herb Crusted Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 1 tsp each of oregano, thyme, onion and garlic
½ cup low sugar orange preserves
instructions: In a zip-top bag, combine the oats, herbs and s&p.
Shake well.
In a small bowl, combine the preserves and mustard and use it to coat the tenders.
Add the chicken to the bag, seal it and shake well to coat all the pieces.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees, line a baking sheet and place the tenders on it.
Bake until golden brown for about 20 minutes.

components.title: Herb Quinoa
ingredients: ¼ cup pine nuts, toasted (optional: or any kind
instructions: Cook the quinoa as directed.
Once it’s cooked, fluff with a fork and add in the herbs and nuts.
Every time you serve this you can add a drizzle of toasted sesame oil or a drizzle of rice wine vinegar to jazz it up.
But don’t store it with the oil or vinegar in it.
Only add it when served.

components.title: Honey Mustard Chicken
instructions: In a bowl, mix the honey, Dijon, apple cider vinegar, garlic and stock.
In a pan add a dash of stock, sprinkle chicken with grill seasoning and cook until done.
Add the honey mixture and let simmer for 2 minutes.
To serve, add parsley on top.

components.title: Spinach Rice Pilaf
instructions: In a saucepan, cook brown rice as instructed and add seasoning to water.
In a skillet with stock cook the onions, red pepper and spinach, sprinkle with seasoning.
Add the cooked rice, fold in the veggies and serve.

components.title: Sweet Potato Chili Fries
ingredients: 4 sweet potatoes, cut into strips (steak fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees.
In a small bowl, combine the cumin and chili powder.
Sprinkle s&p on fries and cover with the spice mixture.
Massage the spices onto them.
Place them on a lined baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes or until cooked.
Right before taking them out of the oven, turn on the broiler for 2 minutes or until toasted.

components.title: Turkey Mole
ingredients: 1 lb turkey breast tenderloins, cut into chunks
instructions: In a food processor, combine the salsa , almonds, chipotle, lime juice, cocoa and process until blended.
In a skillet, with a little broth, cook the turkey until done, add broth and salsa mixture.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to simmer for 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with cilantro and more almonds.

components.title: Black Bean Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Combine the chili powder, cumin and s&p and rub over chicken.
In a skillet with a little broth cook the chicken on both sides until done.
Stir in the black beans, corn and salsa.
Cover and cook over medium for 10 minutes.
Slice chicken and serve over rice and black bean mixture.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken with Sesame Seeds

components.title: Asian Quinoa
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the first 7 ingredients, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until water is absorbed.
Add the remaining ingredients and fluff with a fork.

recipes.note: Grilled chicken with sesame seeds sprinkled on top.

components.title: Turkey Sloppy Joe
ingredients: 1 15-ounce can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a skillet with a little stock, sauté the onions and garlic.
Add the turkey to pan and brown.
Add the carrots, chili powder, grill seasoning, oregano, and brown sugar.
Cook for 2 minutes and stir in the crushed tomatoes and beans.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine mango and cilantro.
Top tilapia with mango mixture just before serving.

components.title: Lemon-Chicken Quinoa Salad
ingredients: ¼ cup almonds, sliced and toasted
instructions: In a small saucepan boil 2 cups of water and add the quinoa, cover reduce heat and simmer until cooked.
Grill the chicken breast with cumin and grill seasoning, until done.
In a large bowl toss the quinoa, chicken breast, lemon zest, parsley, EVOO and almonds.

recipes.name: Turkey and Bean Burger over Brown Rice

components.title: Turkey and Bean Burger
instructions: 1 lime, zested and juiced ½ cup low fat sour cream In a large bowl combine turkey,beans, rice, grill seasoning and spices.
Form into 4 patties.
In a skillet add stock and cook turkey burgers on both side until done.
Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, mash together the acovado, onion, garlic, lime zest and juice and then stir in the sour cream.
Layer mixture on top of turkey burger.

components.title: Blackberry Glazed Salmon
instructions: Season salmon with grill seasoning and bake in a 400 degree oven for 15-20 minutes until done.
In a sauté pan, add a little stock and cook the asparagus until crisp.
Meanwhile in a small bowl, mash ¾ of the berries with the honey, balsamic vinegar, oil and juice.
Mix until chuncky.
To serve, place a handful of arugula on a plate, top with asparagus, add the salmon on top and pour the berry mixture on top.

recipes.name: Spinach Turkey Meatballs & Tomato Basil Rice

components.title: Spinach & Turkey Meatballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Line a cookie sheet with foil.
In a large bowl, combine, egg whites, mozzarella cheese, Parmesan, garlic powder, Italian seasoning and pepper.
Stir in the spinach.
Add ground turkey and mix well.
Shape mixture into small meatballs and place them on cookie sheet.
Bake about 20 minutes or until meatballs are no longer pink.

recipes.name: Brown Rice with Tomatoes and Basil

components.title: Brown Rice with Tomatoes and Basil
ingredients: 1 cup packed basil leaves (1 large bunch), chopped
instructions: Bring 2¼ cups water to a boil and add the rice and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Return to a boil, cover, and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes, until the rice is tender and all the water is absorbed.
Transfer the rice to a bowl.
Whisk together the vinegar, sweetener, olive oil, remaining teaspoon of salt, and a pinch of pepper.
Pour over the rice.
Add the tomatoes and basil.
Mix well and check the seasonings.

components.title: Cheesy Hash Brown Chili
ingredients: 1 15-ounce can kidney beans, rinsed and draine
½ cup part-skim shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat stock over medium heat and add the onion, chili powder and cumin stirring until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste.
Add the turkey and cook, breaking it up for about 5 minutes.
Add the beans and tomatoes with their juices and bring to a boil.
Lower the heat, cover and stir d occasionally.
Top with shredded cheese and serve.

components.title: Brown Spinach Rice
instructions: Cook rice as prescribed, and right before it is done cooking, put the frozen spinach in, mix well, cover and let finish cooking.
May fold in a little Parmesan cheese if desired.

components.title: Chicken Apple Chili
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breast cut in chunks
instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat stock and add chicken, chili powder and cumin.
Season with s&p.
Cook until chicken is browned and transfer to a bow.
In the same pot, add more stock and add apples, onions and cook until softened, add the chicken back in.
Add the chicken stock, beans and simmer for a few minutes.
Add the cheese and stir to combine.

components.title: Tex Mex Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 tsp each garlic powder and onion powder
instructions: Pre-heat the oven to 350 degrees.
Mix all the spices and sprinkle on the chicken on both sides.
Place on a baking dish and bake about 25 minutes or until done.

components.title: Southwestern Brown Rice Pilaf
instructions: In a saucepan, add stock, onion and garlic and cook for a few minutes.
Add the chili powder, cumin and stir until onion is cooked.
Add the rice and s&p to taste.
Toast for a few minutes stirring frequently.
Reduce the heat and add the water and chicken stock, and tomatoes.
Stir once and then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover and let simmer until rice is cooked.
Remove from the heat, fold in the zest of one lime and the cilantro, and serve with lime wedges for spritzing.

components.title: Sun-Dried Tomatoes & Feta Turkey Meatloaf
ingredients: ½ cup reduced fat feta crumbles
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
In a large bowl stir together the yogurt, parsley, garlic, egg whites, sun-dried tomatoes, milk, feta and grill seasoning.
Add the turkey and combine.
Place the mixture on a baking sheet and mold into a think and packed meatloaf.
Bake for 20-25 minute

recipes.name: Veggie Rice Supreme
recipes.note: From Michelle's BeFit Moms recipes. Serve with grilled chicken, steak or fish, as the week 5 calendar says.

components.title: Veggie Rice Supreme
ingredients: ½ cup part skim shredded mozzarella
instructions: Cook brown rice until done.
When the rice is almost done, heat a nonstick skillet with stock, add the veggies and garlic to the pan.
Sprinkle with basil and S&P and sauté for about 5 minutes.
Stir veggies, rice and cheese together and serve.

components.title: Tex Mex Sloppy Joes
instructions: In a large skillet, add stock and brown turkey.
Add red and yellow pepper, and onions and cook until done.
Add chile and garlic powder and grill seasoning and stir.
Stir in tomatoes, corn, broth, tomato paste and balsamic vinegar, bring to a boil.
Reduce to simmer, cover and cook for a few minutes.

components.title: Brown Spinach Rice
instructions: Cook rice as prescribed, and right before it is done cooking, put the frozen spinach in, mix well, cover and let finish cooking.
May fold in a little Parmesan cheese if desired.

components.title: Edamame Quinoa Salad
instructions: Bake, grill or poach chicken breast with grill seasoning until done.
Cut into bite size pieces.
Boil 2 cups of water, add quinoa, reduce hear, cover and simmer until cooked.
Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, add quinoa, chicken and toss gently and serve.
Can substitute chicken for shrimp, scallops, turkey tenderloin or tofu.

components.title: Easy Chicken Chili
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with their juice
instructions: In a deep skillet over medium heat with a little stock, add the onions, garlic, oregano, cumin, chili powder, and paprika.
Cook until onion is translucent.
Add the chicken and cook until done.
Stir in the tomatoes and beans and bring to a boil.
Lower heat and simmer for a few minutes.
Take off of the heat and stir in the yogurt and cilantro.

components.title: Barbecue Fit Chicken
ingredients: 2 tbsp coconut sugar or brown sugar
1 tsp each of garlic powder, onion
powder, dry mustard, paprika and cumin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350degrees.
Season the chicken with grill seasoning and bake for 20 minutes or until done.
Meanwhile, in a small saucepan combine the remaining ingredients and bring to a simmer until slightly thickened.
Once chicken is cooked, dice it and put it in the barbecue sauce and fold well.

components.title: Fruity Rice Salad
ingredients: ¼ to ⅓ cup sliced almonds, toasted
instructions: Cook rice and quinoa per instructions.
Fold the quinoa into the rice.
In a large bowl whisk the lime juice, zest, EVOO, vinegar and s&p to taste.
Add the rice and quinoa mixture to the bowl, folding in the cucumber, mango, scallions and cilantro.
Mix well and then fold in the almonds.

components.title: Fresh Turkey Veg Skillet
ingredients: 1 tsp fresh or dried rosemary, chopped
instructions: Pre-heat the oven to 425 degrees.
Place the potatoes and tomatoes on a lined baking sheet and sprinkle with s&p and thyme.
Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, in a deep skillet with a little stock, cook the ground turkey until done.
Sprinkle with grill seasoning, rosemary, and add the spinach and wilt with stock.
Add the lemon juice and the veggies and fold well.
Top with the feta crumbles.

components.title: Rasberry Chicken Salad
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together preserves, oil, vinegar, mustard, s&p.
Add scallions, raspberries and chicken.
Toss well.

components.title: Mexican Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 tsp each of chili powder and cumin
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl except for the avocado.
Serve with sliced avocado on top.

components.title: Roasted Asparagus With Citrus Dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.
Ona baking sheet add the asparagus and tomatoes and sprinkle with S&P.
Roast about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk lemon and orange juice with honey and mustard.
When the asparagus and tomatoes are done pour dressing over them and top with feta.

components.title: Fresh Lentil Salad
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine lentils, bay leaves, thyme, carrot, celery, shallot, and garlic.
Cook until soft.
Cover with water by 1-inch and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer until tender.
Drain and discard thyme and bay leaves.
Set aside and let cool.
Meanwhile mix the vinaigrette.
Whisk together the vinegar, shallot, mustard and s&p to taste.
Whisk in the oil and add to the cooled lentils and fold well.

components.title: Sweet BBQ Sloppy Joes
ingredients: 1½ lbs extra lean ground turkey breast
instructions: In a large skillet, add a little stock and add the turkey and brown.
Add the poultry seasoning and stir in the peppers, onions, and garlic and cook until tender.
In a bowl, stir together the tomato sauce, vinegars, syrup, brown sugar and mustard.
Pour the sauce over the turkey and veggies and simmer over low heat for a few minutes.

components.title: Cheesy Turkey Meatloaf
ingredients: 1-2 lbs extra lean ground turkey breast
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 375 degrees.
Ina skillet with a little stock, cook the onions and garlic until tender.
Let cool, and add to a bowl.
Add the ½ cup ketchup and remaining ingredients and mix well.
Form into a meatloaf on a foil covered baking pan.
In a small bowl, combine the remaining ketchup with a little balsamic vinegar and top the meatloaf.
Bake for 20-25 minutes.

components.title: Tuscan Chicken
ingredients: ½ tsp fresh rosemary, chopped or dried
2 cans cannelini beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a sauté pan with a little stock, brown the chicken with a little grill seasoning.
Remove chicken from the pan and cook the onion and garlic until translucent.
Stir in the spinach, rosemary, beans and tomatoes.
Cook for a few minutes.
Add in the chicken and Let simmer for a few more minutes.

components.title: Asian Chicken
instructions: Pre-heat the oven to 350 degrees.
Combine vinegars, oil, honey and garlic in a plastic bag.
Add chicken to bag, seal and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour.
Place the marinade ina sauté pan and bring to a boil, cook until syrupy.
Ina lined baking sheet, place the chicken and sprinkle with a little salt.
Baste some of the marinade on the chicken and bake for 10 minutes.
Baste the chicken one more time and cook for another 5-10 minutes.
Once cooked, drizzle a little more marinade on the chicken.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and scallions.

components.title: Edamame Rice
ingredients: Black or white sesame seeds, toasted (optional)
brown sugar or honey to taste
instructions: In a sauté pan with a little stock, toast the rice.
Add 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until almost done.
When the rice almost dries, add in the edamame and fold well.
Once cooked, take off heat, and fold in the cilantro and scallions and sesame seeds (optional).
Whisk together the EVOO, vinegar, sweetener and s&P.
Fold into the rice and serve.

components.title: Avocado Egg White Salad
instructions: In a bowl, combine all the ingredients and serve.

components.title: Greek White Fish
ingredients: 1 cup crumbled reduced-fat or organic feta cru!
¼ cup milk almond or dairy free if possible
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees.
Line a baking sheet and place the fish on it.
Sprinkle the fish with grill seasoning.
In a small bowl, combine the poles egg, cheese, milk and pepper.
Spoon the mixture over the fish.
Top it with the tomatoes and pine nuts and bake for 15-20 minutes or until done.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the parsley and lemon juice and drizzle over the fish before serving.

components.title: Nutty Pear Or Apple Chicken
ingredients: 2 tsp fresh or 1 tsp dried rosemary
3 pears or apples, peeled, cored, diced
½ cup walnuts, toasted and chopped
instructions: In a sauté pan, add a little broth, sprinkle the chicken with grill seasoning and cook until browned.
Set aside.
In the same pan, add a little more broth and sauté the shallots, garlic, rosemary, and pears/apples.
Cook until done.
Add the chicken back in the pan, and fold in with the veggies.
Add in the honey, vinegar and lemon juice.
Mix well and top with walnuts.

components.title: Baked Mexican Meatballs
instructions: In a large bowl, mix all the meatball ingredients, mix well and form into small meatballs.
Place ina 350-degree oven for about 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a large sauté pan with a little stock, cook the onions and garlic until translucent.
Then add the crushed tomatoes and chili powder.
Cook for a few minutes and when meatballs are cooked add them in the pan, let them simmer and get incorporated with the sauce for a few minutes.
Pour into a baking dish and top with cheese and bake for about 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with cilantro and serve.

components.title: Artichoke Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 1 can quartered artichoke hearts, rinsed, drained and chopped finely
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Meanwhile in a bowl, mix the yogurt, artichokes and Parmesan cheese.
Sprinkle grill seasoning on both sides of the chicken and bake for 10 minutes.
Take the chicken out of the oven, add the artichoke mixture and bake for another 10 minutes.

components.title: Creamy Cauliflower Rice
instructions: In a saucepan with a little stock, cook the garlic, and toast the rice.
Add the water and cook until done.
In another large saucepan, boil the cauliflower until softened.
In a food processor, add the cauliflower, yogurt, s&p to taste, and stock if needed to thin out.
When the rice is cooked, take off the heat, add the cauliflower mixture, fold in well, add mozzarella if using, and fold again.

components.title: Tex-Mex Turkey Meatloaf
ingredients: ½ cup fresh salsa, plus more for the top
1 tbsp each of oregano, cumin and chili powder
½ cup or more Greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine all the ingredients and mix well.
Mold into a meatloaf on a lined baking sheet.
Top with salsa and bake for 20-25 minutes.

snacks.title: Blueberry Chip Cookies
ingredients: 2-3 tbsp dairy and gluten free chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Meanwhile, In a small saute pan, cook the blueberries for a few minutes until juicy, plump and almost melted.
Then place all the ingredients in a food processor except the chocolate chips.
Pulse well to incorporate, fold in the chips and place in a parchment paper lined baking dish and bake for ~14 minutes.

snacks.title: Chunky Monkey Protein Muffins
ingredients: 1 scoop vanilla protein powder (I use Prograde)
1/4 cup dairy and gluten free chocolate chips
instructions: Pre-heat the oven to 350 degrees.
Mix all the wet ingredients and then mix the dry ingredients into it and then fold in the walnuts and chocolate chips.
Place in a coconut oil or spray lined muffin pan and bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through.

snacks.title: Banana Bread Protein Bars
ingredients: 2/3 cups oats (I use Bob’s Red Mill Gluten-Free)
1/2 cup Almond Meal (I use Bob’s Red Mill)
1 scoop vanilla protein powder (I use Prograde)
2-3 tbsp chia seeds (I use Bob’s Red Mill)
3 tbsp gluten & dairy free chocolate chips (I use
2-4 tbsp agave nectar or coconut sugar or brown
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Line a 8x8 square pan with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, mix the bananas, almond butter, agave or sugar and vanilla extract.
Then add cinnamon, oats, almond flour, protein powder and mix well.
If you need to, add a tablespoon or more of applesauce to loosen the mixture.
Fold in the walnuts, chia seeds, freeze dried bananas and chocolate chips if using.
Mix well and pour the batter into the lined pan and with a spoon, make sure it is even.
Bake for ~ 25 minutes or until done.
Let it cool before serving.

snacks.title: Apple Cinnamon Bites
ingredients: 3 tbsp coconut sugar or brown sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Mix all the ingredients in a large bowl, except the apples.
Fold in the apples and nuts at the end and place in a muffin pan.
Bake for 15- 20 minutes or until done.

snacks.title: No Bake Chocolate Chip Protein Balls
ingredients: 1 tbsp flaxmeal (I use Bob’s Red Mill)
2 tbsp dairy and gluten-free chocolate chips (I
2 tbsp vanilla protein powder (I use Prograde)
3/4 cup Gluten-Free Oats (I use Bob’s Red Mill
instructions: Mash the banana with almond butter and extract.
Then mix in the rest of the ingredients and with a small ice cream scooper, scoop little balls onto a parchment paper lined baking sheet.
Let them sit in the fridge for about an hour before trying.

snacks.title: Love At First Bite Granola Bars
ingredients: 1/2 cup almond butter, cashew butter, sun butter
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the nut butter with coconut oil and agave.
Turn off heat and fold in the rest of the ingredients.
Pour into an 8x8 baking dish and refrigerate for at least an hour.

snacks.title: Pumpkin Protein Pancakes
instructions: Put all of the ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth!
Meanwhile, heat a nonstick griddle or large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray (coconut oil spray if you can) over medium heat.
Use an ice cream scooper to scoop the batter into griddle or skillet to make the same size pancakes.
When the pancakes start to bubble, flip them over and cook until done.
The seconds side cooks much faster.

snacks.title: Avocado Egg Salad
instructions: In a bowl, combine eggs, onions, celery, avocado and mustard.
Stir well and add paprika and s&p to taste.

snacks.title: The Best Protein Chocolate Chip Cookies Ever
ingredients: Sweetener to taste (brown sugar, agave, etc)
3-4 tbsp dairy & gluten free chocolate chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Meanwhile, in a bowl mash the banana with applesauce, almond butter and extract.
Then mix in the oats, sweetener, and protein powder.
Mix well and then fold in chocolate chips.
Place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.

snacks.title: Oatmeal Muffins
ingredients: 1 tsp vanilla, coconut, maple or almond extract

Toppings or fillings, pick any: ¼ cup freeze dried berries, ¼ cup chopped walnuts, ¼ cup sliced almonds, ¼ cup shredded coconut, ¼ cup dairy and gluten-free chocolate chips, ¼ cup fresh berries or banana
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Meanwhile, in a bowl mix all the dry ingredients (first 5 ingredients).
In a separate bowl, mix the wet ingredients (banana through applesauce).
Then mix dry into wet ingredients and mix well.
Fold in any of the topping or filling ingredients it or use them just as topping or both.
Bake fro 30 minutes or until done.

snacks.title: Gluten-Free Brownies
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
¼ to ⅓ cup honey or agave
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 F.
Combine all ingredients except chips in a good food processor, and blend until completely smooth.
Really blend well.
Stir in the chips, then pour into a greased (with coconut oil) 8x8 pan.
Optional: sprinkle extra chocolate chips over the top.
Cook the black bean brownies 15-18 minutes, then let cool at least 10 minutes before trying to cut.
If they still look a bit undercooked, you can place them in the fridge overnight and they will firm up.

snacks.title: Strawberry Protein Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup plain low fat Greek yogurt
Sweetener to taste (honey, agave, brown sugar, coconut sugar)
1 cup strawberries, half inside the batter and half for the top
Almond milk (¼ cup plus), added to the blender as needed to get the right consistency
½ cup almonds or walnuts (optional), for crunch and healthy fats
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees and spray a muffin pan (silicone if you have one) with coconut oil spray and wipe down.
Place all of the ingredients except the strawberries in a blender or food processor, and blend until the oats are smooth.
Fold in half the strawberries.
Pour into the muffin pan and top off with a few strawberries.
Bake for about 20 minutes or until golden brown and done.

snacks.title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: ¼ cup coconut oil, melted and cooled
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Meanwhile in a large bowl, mix the bananas, coconut oil and extract.
Add in the rest of the ingredients except chocolate chips and mix well.
Fold in the chocolate chips and dollop onto a parchment paper lined baking sheet and bake for approximately 14 minutes.

snacks.title: Raspberry Chicken Salad
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together preserves, oil, vinegar, mustard, s&p.
Add scallions, raspberries and chicken.
Toss well.

breakfasts.title: Banana Split Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 ½ tbsp gluten and dairy free chocolate chips
instructions: Cook the oatmeal on the stove or microwave in almond milk.
Meanwhile, toast the almonds on a skillet and smash the banana in a bowl.
Pour the cooked oatmeal over the banana and top with chocolate chips and almonds.
Mix well and devour.

breakfasts.title: Vegetable Frittata
instructions: Saute your favorite veggies chopped up in a skillet over medium heat with a little low sodium organic stock.
Add your favorite herbs and spices to the veggies while you cook them.
In a bowl, whisk 8 egg whites and 4 whole eggs with 1/4 cup of whatever milk you use, preferably non-dairy.
Once the veggies have cooled, fold them into the egg mixture, sprinkle a little bit of your favorite cheese (this is optional), and mix well.
Pour the mixture into a dish like this: And bake at 350 degrees for about 25-30 minutes or until it is golden brown and done.
Optional: You can add healthy carbs to it, by shredding some sweet potatoes, cooking them on the stove until they are golden and use that as a crust on the baking dish before you add the egg mixture!
YUMMMM- OOOOO.

breakfasts.title: BeFit Moms Oatmeal Pancake
ingredients: Sweetener to taste: Agave Nectar, Coconut Sugar
instructions: In a blender, blend all the ingredients (except if using any fruit other than banana, which you would fold in to the batter).
Cook on a small skillet at medium heat like a normal pancake.

breakfasts.title: Coconut Mango Protein Shake
ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk plus water to desired texture
1 scoop vanilla protein powder (I use Prograde)
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender and enjoy!

breakfasts.title: Nutty Choco-Nana Protein Shake
instructions: Blend all ingredients and serve cold.

breakfasts.title: Blue-Nana Protein Shake
ingredients: 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, I used Prograde
1/2 cup almond milk + 1/4 cup or more of water
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a blender.

breakfasts.title: Coco-Choco Chunky Monkey
ingredients: 2 scoops Vanilla protein powder (I use Prograde)
1/2 cup or less water (to your desired
1/2 frozen banana (put a banana in freezer)
instructions: On stove, melt the chocolate chips in the almond milk and let cool, then place that and the rest of the ingredients in the blender and blend until smooth.

breakfasts.title: Zucchini & Spinach Frittata
breakfasts.note: From Michelle's Eat to be Fit cooking class #7. Make it Saturday and the leftovers cover a couple more mornings.
instructions: In a skillet with a little stock, cook the zucchini, spinach and thyme with a little S&P until the spinach is wilted and the zucchini is cooked. Let cool.
Meanwhile, whisk the eggs and cottage cheese and add the veggie mixture in.
Pour into a 9-inch pie plate and bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until done.

Produce: Freeze Dried Blueberries, Strawberries or Raspberries

Dairy: Feta Crumbles Reduced Fat Cottage Cheese

intro: Your Pregnancy nutrition is extremely important.
It doesn’t just affect you, but it affects your baby as well.

Plus, they say that they acquire a taste to foods and nutrients you eat during pregnancy, so it’s a good idea to eat all kinds of different foods and nutrients to increase the chances of you having a good eater and not a picky one.
My goal for you this pregnancy is to also diminish any morning sickness, increase your energy, and help you not gain any excess weight.
After 2 amazing pregnancies with only 20 lbs of weight gain in each and incredible experiences, as well as helping thousands of pregnant women accomplish the same, I have the perfect plan for you.
I know that most women get tons of cravings, especially for carbohydrates.

So I made sure to include healthy carbs in every meal as well as give you some incredibly amazing and yummy snacks that you can have to satisfy that sweet tooth without the bad calories and poor nutrition.

I know how stressful pregnancy can be in it of itself with all the new changes coming soon, and the lack of energy and all the work you are doing to the house to prepare for the baby, not to mention the financial stress that you are probably thinking about.
So I want to ease your stress by giving you a nutrition plan that is easy to follow, enjoyable and will deliver great results.
I don’t want you to have to stress about what you should eat and what you should cook, etc. So I have done all the work for you.
In this Nutrition Guide, you are to eat every 2-3 hours.
Please do not allow yourself to get hungry as that will increase your chances of feeling sick as well as will make you feel weak, fatigued and cranky.
It will also make you incredibly hungry for the following meal, which will most likely make you OVER-EAT for that next meal.
Plan to have 3 main meals and 2-4 snacks per day, depending on what time you wake up and go to sleep and your activity level.
Each week is divided by days and each day has 3 meals.
Your dinners will be the main meals you cook for.
how: I want you to cook double or even triple the recipe’s servings so that you can have extra food left over because you will be eating left over’s from dinner for the next day’s lunch and maybe even snacks if you are in the mood for them.

This will save you tons of time and will ensure you have a healthy lunch ready for you the next day so this will prevent you from eating out, picking at “Bad Food”, and making poor choices, or end up feeling sick because you have no food available.
This will ensure that you are always prepared and being prepared is key!
For the 8 weeks, you have a total of 14 recipes for snacks.
I also gave you a bunch of other options that you can have that are just easy on-the -go snacks that you can just have in your fridge or pantry at all times.

You have a few different breakfast meals every day, but if you are one of those creatures of habit and you like having the same thing every day, that is ok, but just for breakfast. I want you to vary all your other meals so that you get enough of all the nutrients you and your baby need. Remember that everything you do now is affecting your baby too.
I am giving you 8 weeks of meal plans and recipes.
You can repeat these 8 weeks for the duration of your pregnancy.
I am sure that you will find your favorite meals and recipes and please, feel free after you try them all to swap one day for another or to make your favorites weekly.

So if I you are on week 3 but there is a recipe from week 1 that you love, feel free to make and eat that one instead. But try them all  I just want you to enjoy yourself, eat enough of the right nutrients, prevent morning sickness and have tons of energy so that you are in a good mood and can enjoy your pregnancy.
Sticking to your plan will help you only gain the weigh that is necessary. And if you do this, you will be able to lose your baby weight super fast.
steps: 2. At the beginning of the week take your Grocery List to the store and stock up on everything that you will need for the whole week.
3. At the beginning of each week, bake 2 different batches of snacks to have for the week. Most of these you can also have for breakfast.
4. Plan your days out ahead of time and if you are on the go or working, make sure to pack up your meals and/or snacks and take them with you. Try to do this the night before.
5. If you need to, set alarms or notifications to remind you to eat every few hours. Remember that when you get hungry all heck can break loose.
6. Look at your week and days at a glance and plan ahead with your cooking. If you have a busy week, maybe you need to cook 2 days of dinners on 1 night.

7. This isn’t a diet so all things in moderation. If you are craving a bagel, have a bagel, just don’t eat a bagel every day. If you want some cookies, have just a few, but don’t eat 5 cookies every day. If when you fall off the wagon, you do so in moderation, you will still be in good shape.
8. Drink a lot of water. Get in the habit of having a bottle of water with you at all times. The last thing you want is water retention weight on top of the weight you are already gaining.

9. You may want to have some protein bars on hand at all times just in case you don’t get a chance to cook your healthy snacks or you run out of them and don’t have time to bake them for a few days. There is only one protein bar I have found is healthy enough to eat during pregnancy and that is Dale’s Raw Protein Bars and that is not because they are raw, but because they are made with 100% natural ingredients and they are organic and have no GMO’s. You can only get them online, here is the link. I always had one box in the freezer and one in the fridge. I pretty much took one with me daily every where I went. They are yummy too! Link: http://dalesrawfoods. com#oid=1108_1

Any pre-packaged foods that say Fat-Free or Sugar-Free
